definitions.explanation: A room in a school that functions as a library where students can read and borrow books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{図書室|としょしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read books in the library during lunch break.

examples.japanese: {図書室|としょしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I study in the library room.

examples.japanese: {図書室|としょしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{図書室|としょしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read books in the library during lunch break.

examples.japanese: {図書室|としょしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しなければならない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You must be quiet in the library.

notes:
{図書室|としょしつ} specifically refers to a library room within a school or building, not a standalone library. The kanji break down as ⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧ (books) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room).

KEY DISTINCTION:
- {図書室|としょしつ}: library room (a room inside a school, office, etc.)
- ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧: library (a standalone building or public institution)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図書室|としょしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read books in the library room
- {図書室|としょしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to borrow books from the library room
- {図書室|としょしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べ{物|もの}→調べ物：03071_shirabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do research in the library room

USAGE:
Most commonly associated with ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧ (elementary school) and ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ (junior high school) libraries. High schools and universities more often have a ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧.
